content.short: Gun is an ecosystem of tools that lets you build community-run and encrypted applications.
content.description: Gun is a compact, fast protocol for syncing data and encrypting it securely. It works with both SQL and NoSQL data and uses cryptography to secure the data itself rather than the servers. It introduces Public space, User space (where only the owner can write), and Frozen space (one-time write, readable by everyone) to support decentralization at a fundamental level, ensuring that control and access are governed by the data model itself rather than centralized infrastructure.
